name: kanban-service
description: CargoDesk Kanban/Testing Service — tickets, ticket_links, test_items, test_case_links, kb_projects, kb_versions, kb_columns. Called only by the monolith over an internal, secret-gated HTTP API (see server.js's own /internal gate) — never exposed to the browser. Resolved dependencies (express) are hoisted from the repo root's node_modules — no separate install step.
